name: AI Content Guide – LLMs Text Generator
author: Fulgid

sections.description:
AI Content Guide generates llms.txt files for your WordPress site, helping AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity better understand your content.

Based on the llms.txt specification, this plugin creates a standardized file that provides AI systems with a structured overview of your website, improving how your content appears in AI-generated responses.

Key Features

  • Automatic File Generation: Creates and maintains llms.txt files based on your site content
  • SEO Integration: Works with popular SEO plugins like Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress
  • Content Control: Choose which post types, pages, and taxonomies to include
  • Full AI Optimization: Generates both standard llms.txt and comprehensive llms-full.txt files
  • Robots.txt Integration: Optionally adds references to your llms.txt file in robots.txt
  • Custom Content: Add additional information to your llms.txt file to better guide AI systems
  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight with minimal impact on site speed
  • Developer Friendly: Includes hooks and filters for customization

Why llms.txt Matters

As AI-powered search becomes increasingly important, having an llms.txt file is like having robots.txt for AI systems. It helps ensure:

  1. Better Visibility: Improves your content’s discoverability in AI-generated responses
  2. Accurate Citations: Helps AI systems correctly reference your content
  3. Competitive Edge: Positions your site for the emerging AI-powered search landscape
  4. SEO Complement: Works alongside your existing SEO strategies

How It Works

The plugin analyzes your WordPress content and generates a structured markdown file that follows the llms.txt specification. This file is made available at the root of your website (e.g., yoursite.com/llms.txt) where AI systems can access it.

The plugin automatically respects your SEO settings, excluding content marked as “noindex” and using your meta descriptions for better content summaries.

Privacy & Data

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All processing happens locally on your server. The generated llms.txt file contains only the public content you choose to include.

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit:
* Plugin Documentation
* Support Forum
* GitHub Repository (if applicable)

Contributing

We welcome contributions! If you’d like to contribute to the development of this plugin, please visit our GitHub repository or contact us through our website.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI Content Guide”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the ai-content-guide-llms-text-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Setup

  1. Go to the ‘AI Content Guide’ menu item in your admin dashboard
  2. Configure your settings on the Content Settings tab
  3. Review File Settings for delivery method
  4. Click ‘Save Settings’
  5. Click ‘Regenerate Now’ to create your llms.txt file
  6. Verify your file is accessible at yoursite.com/llms.txt
sections.faq:
What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is a proposed standard file format, similar to robots.txt, that helps AI systems better understand website content. It provides a structured way for website owners to present their most important content to Large Language Models (LLMs). Learn more at llmstxt.org.

Will this improve my search engine rankings?

llms.txt primarily targets AI systems rather than traditional search engines. While it may not directly affect your traditional SEO rankings, it can improve how your content appears in AI-generated responses, which is becoming increasingly important as AI-powered search grows.

Does this work with my SEO plugin?

Yes! The plugin integrates seamlessly with popular SEO plugins including:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO
* SEOPress

It respects your SEO settings, excluding content marked as “noindex” and using your meta descriptions for better content summaries.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is designed for performance:
* Files are generated in the background
* Served efficiently using WordPress rewrite rules
* Minimal database queries
* No impact on frontend page load times

How often is the llms.txt file updated?

The file is automatically updated:
* When you publish or update content
* When you change plugin settings
* You can also manually regenerate it anytime from the admin panel

Can I customize what’s included in the llms.txt file?

Absolutely! You have full control over:
* Which post types to include (posts, pages, custom post types)
* Which taxonomies to include (categories, tags, custom taxonomies)
* Maximum number of posts per type
* Custom introduction text
* Additional custom content

What’s the difference between llms.txt and llms-full.txt?

  • llms.txt: A concise overview of your most important content
  • llms-full.txt: A comprehensive version with more detailed content (optional)

Both follow the llms.txt specification but serve different use cases.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin works with all major caching plugins. The llms.txt file is served via WordPress rewrite rules and doesn’t interfere with caching mechanisms.

Does this plugin collect any data?

No. This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All processing happens locally on your server, and the generated files contain only the public content you choose to include.

How do I verify my llms.txt file is working?

  1. Visit yoursite.com/llms.txt in your browser
  2. Check the plugin’s status dashboard for file accessibility
  3. Use the built-in preview feature in the admin panel
